clues: This city lies in the state of Pennsylvania, in the east of the United States. It is the main city of its county area.
Rain falls most here in September, and least in February. Summers are hot, winters are cold, and the heat can swing a lot.
The Pennsylvania Railroad set up this city in 1849. It grew around the train works and the tracks.
Its ball team is a farm team for the Pittsburgh Pirates. Young players train here on their way to the main team.
Its best known sight is a great bend in the rail tracks, curved like a horse's shoe. Its museum honours rail workers of days gone by.
